title: Wolfsklamm und St. Georgenberg
highlights: Eine der wildromantischsten Schluchten der Alpen mit 354 Holzstufen ueber tosenden Wassern
Smaragdgruene Gumpen, tosendes Wildwasser und jahrhundertealte Felsarchitektur
Historische Hohe Bruecke aus Stein und Holz als aeltester Steinbrueckenbau Tirols

kurzbeschreibung: The Wolfsklamm in Stans leads via 354 steps and wooden footbridges through a roaring gorge up to the cliff monastery of St. Georgenberg.
beschreibung:
Wildly Romantic Natural Monument of the Karwendel

Ever since its opening in 1901, the Wolfsklamm in Stans has been considered one of the most beautiful gorges in the Alpine region. Ascending 354 wooden steps, walkways, and galleries carved into the rock, the path winds alongside the roaring Stanser Bach through the narrow limestone canyon.

Pilgrimage Route to Tyrol's Oldest Place of Pilgrimage

At the upper exit of the gorge, hikers cross the heritage-protected Hohe Brücke dating from 1497 to reach the monastery of St. Georgenberg, perched picturesquely atop a solitary rock pinnacle. This storied pilgrimage site invites visitors to pause for refreshment and silent contemplation.
